name: gdpr
description: GDPR/RODO document pack from the real app: scans code, DB schema and config for personal data, processors and retention, then drafts RoPA, privacy policy, DPA (art. 28), DPIA screening, TOMs, data subject rights procedure and breach procedure. Use when dev says "rodo", "gdpr", "DPA", "polityka prywatnosci", "RoPA", "DPIA", "paczka dokumentow prawnych", or invokes /gdpr.
